mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_index.document_indexes (bucket_name, file_key, index_profile, source_hash, collection_name, status, chunk_count, error_message, indexed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{bucketName}, #{fileKey}, #{indexProfile}, #{sourceHash}, #{collectionName}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{indexedAt}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (bucket_name, file_key, index_profile) DO UPDATE SET source_hash = EXCLUDED.source_hash, collection_name = EXCLUDED.collection_name, status = EXCLUDED.status, chunk_count = EXCLUDED.chunk_count, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, indexed_at = EXCLUDED.indexed_at, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_index.document_indexes WHERE bucket_name = #{bucketName} AND file_key = #{fileKey}
